Cittabhaṅgā.g: cuticittassa viya sabbassapi tassa tassa cittassa bhaṅgappattiyā ayaṁ loko paramatthato mato nāma hoti “atīte cittakkhaṇe jīvittha na jīvati na jīvissatī”ti vattabbato, niruddhassa appaṭisandhikattā.

Cittabhāvanā.g: cittaṭṭhiti cittapariggaho natthi, natthibhāveneva “natthī”ti vadāmīti dasseti.
cittaṭṭhiti cittapariggaho atthi, atthibhāveneva “atthī”ti vadāmīti dasseti.

cittabhāvo.g: yaṁ yaṁ yoniṁ kammaṁ satte upaneti, taṁtaṁyonimūlako tesaṁ sattānaṁ cittavicittabhāvo.

Cittabhaggā.g: dvīhi cittehi ekakkhaṇe ajīvanabhāvena cittabhaṅgena mato.

cittabhāvanā.g: tassa mandapaññassa vipassanācittabhāvanā kilesesuyeva ṭhānato paṭipakkhāvihatattā cavati, paripatatīti attho.
tassa vipassanācittabhāvanā na cavati, vikkhepakilesābhāvena yathāṭhāne tiṭṭhatīti attho.
